issue.title: Better integration with qiskit-addon-dice-solver

repository.name: qiskit-addon-sqd
repository.description: Sample-based Quantum Diagonalization: Classically postprocess noisy quantum samples to yield more accurate eigenvalue estimations.

issue.body:
### What should we add?

I'd like to have it so that if the user has `qiskit-addon-dice-solver` installed, there is an easy way to switch to using it as the solver underlying the high-level function to be introduced in #191 .

body: Thanks @kevinsung , the reason we didn't do something like this to begin with is due to the need to parallelize the batches for most problems. Does the ``callback`` handle this here?

> Thanks [@kevinsung](https://github.com/kevinsung) , the reason we didn't do something like this to begin with is due to the need to parallelize the batches for most problems. Does the `callback` handle this here?

No, the `callback` is for allowing the user to save information from each iteration. I acknowledge that parallelization might be tricky here, and is something to be discussed.
